title: MedSparse Healthcare LLM — From Scratch, Pretraining & Medical SFT
description: End-to-end PyTorch implementation of MedSparse Healthcare, a Mixtral-inspired sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model: a healthcare-focused tokenizer, biomedical pretraining from randomly initialized weights, and full-parameter medical supervised fine-tuning. Explore the four-expert, top-2-routed decoder architecture, training checkpoints, evaluation workflow, and two separately hosted Hugging Face model releases.
keywords: PyTorch Sparse MoE Medical SFT Hugging Face

title: Multi-Tenant Retrieval & RAG Service
description: Qdrant, FastAPI, tenant-scoped retrieval and semantic caching; retrieval responses rather than unverified generated answers.

title: Multi-Agent Workflows with LangGraph
description: StateGraph workflows, Pydantic validation, reducers, MessagesState and reusable HR/IT subgraphs.

title: LLM Fine-Tuning & Preference Optimization
description: Qwen2.5 LoRA tuning with separate SmolLM-based SFT→DPO and ORPO pipelines, using version-isolated training stacks.

title: Distributed LLM Training with PyTorch DDP
description: torchrun workers, DistributedSampler, gradient synchronization and Qwen LoRA training workflows with independent model replicas.

title: Parallel LLM Batch Inference
description: Qwen2.5 batch sentiment inference with Python worker queues, per-device model replicas, JSONL validation and ordered outputs.

title: Transformer Encoder from Scratch
description: Custom multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, pre-LayerNorm blocks and classification on Yelp-style review data.

title: DistilBERT Full vs. Frozen Fine-Tuning
description: Full-encoder fine-tuning compared with frozen-backbone classification, weighted F1, confusion matrices and saved checkpoints.

title: Transformer Training & Model Evaluation
description: DistilBERT-based support-text classification, full and frozen-backbone configurations, evaluation and prediction outputs.

title: MCP & LangGraph Market Workflow Simulation
description: LangChain tools, LangGraph routing and STDIO/HTTP MCP servers for simulated stock quotes, synthetic news and non-executing trade actions.

title: Tiny GPT-Style Language Model from Scratch
description: 1.06M-parameter decoder-only GPT-style model from scratch trained from random weights on a TinyStories subset, with a custom BPE tokenizer, CUDA training and Hugging Face-compatible checkpoint export.
